instances.disagree_when: ANALYTICAL: self + rhs >= 2^32 in U32 (gate: fail; fresh: wraps then subtracts P when >= P). Witness: self = rhs = 4294967295#u32. Equal for self, rhs < P = 2147483647 (no checked op can fail: self+rhs < 2^32, `s - P` is guarded by s >= P).

ANALYTICAL: self + P >= 2^32, i.e. self >= 2147483649, or rhs > self + P (U32 underflow). Witness: self = 4294967295, rhs = 0 (gate fails at self + P). Equal for self, rhs < P (the `s - P` is guarded by s >= P).

ANALYTICAL: never. Both U32 factors are cast to U64, so the U64 product is at most (2^32-1)^2 < 2^64: no overflow, so gate and fresh agree on all inputs. The equality needs a no-overflow lemma (not provable by rfl/unfold, which is why the generated stage 2 failed).

ANALYTICAL: never. i1 = x & P <= P, i2 = x >> 31 < 2^33, so x1 < 2^34; the second round sums stay below 2^32 + 2^31; `x3 - P` is guarded by x3 >= P. All checked ops succeed for every U64 x; the equality needs this bound lemma.
